name: Graceful Rate Limit Handling
description: FADE's execution loop should detect Claude Code rate limits and exit gracefully with helpful messaging, rather than treating them as unexpected errors.

context.problem: When Claude Code hits session/rate limits during FADE execution (especially in ALL/YOLO mode), the loop sees no exit signal (STORY_DONE, ALL_COMPLETE, BLOCKED) and exits with a confusing error message suggesting something went wrong.
context.currentBehavior: Loop outputs 'No exit signal detected. Stopping loop.' and 'Expected one of: STORY_DONE, ALL_COMPLETE, BLOCKED' - which looks like an error when it's actually just a rate limit.
context.desiredBehavior: FADE detects rate limit messages, exits cleanly, preserves progress context, and provides clear next steps for resumption.

userStories.title: Detect rate limit in Claude output
userStories.description: As a FADE user, I want the execution loop to recognize Claude's rate limit message so that it doesn't treat it as an error condition.
acceptanceCriteria: Loop detects 'You've hit your limit' pattern in Claude output
Detection works regardless of timezone or reset time format
Rate limit is treated as a known exit condition, not an error

userStories.title: Clean exit with helpful messaging
userStories.description: As a FADE user, I want clear feedback when rate-limited so that I know what happened and what to do next.
acceptanceCriteria: Exit message clearly indicates rate limit (not error)
Reset time is displayed if parseable from Claude output
Suggests commands to resume (fade run or fade yolo)

userStories.title: Preserve session context on rate limit
userStories.description: As a FADE user, I want my progress preserved when rate-limited so that I can seamlessly resume later.
acceptanceCriteria: Current PRD and story context noted in exit message
Optional: append rate limit note to progress.md
User knows exactly where to pick up

userStories.title: Handle other Claude interruptions
userStories.description: As a FADE user, I want FADE to handle other non-error interruptions gracefully (network issues, Claude service issues, etc.).
acceptanceCriteria: Pattern matching extensible for other known interruption types
Generic 'session interrupted' handling for unrecognized stops
All interruptions suggest appropriate next steps

knownPatterns: You've hit your limit · resets Xpm (timezone)
You've hit your limit · resets Xam (timezone)
technicalNotes.implementation: Modify the output parsing in fade run/yolo loop to check for rate limit patterns before checking for exit signals
